        How trade-in works
        1. Upgrade and save
        Accept your estimated trade-in value, buy your new device at the current price, and receive your delivery.

        Sign out of all accounts linked to your old device, and factory reset it to erase your personal information.

        About this item

        • CREATED FOR YOUR CONTENT: Any way you turn it, the new Galaxy Z Fold8 gives you a fuller viewing experience. Designed with your content in mind, this foldable phone is the perfect size to make your movies, books and more incredibly immersive.
        • WORLD’S LIGHTEST FOLD¹: Galaxy Z Fold8 is the newest foldable phone for content on the go. Unfolded, it fits movies and books for an immersive experience. Folded, it delivers comfortable texting and everyday use — all on the world’s lightest fold.¹
        • THE BRIGHTEST DISPLAY ON A GALAXY PHONE: Our brightest smartphone display² provides you with a comfortable view, whether you’re inside or outside. Watch movies, play games and scroll with ease no matter where you are.
        • RECORD. REFRAME. READY FOR SOCIAL³: Record content on Galaxy Z Fold8 and then use My FanCam³ to keep your subject center stage. The result is a social-ready video that focuses on the part of the action you really want.
        • UNTETHER YOUR ENTERTAINMENT: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy Z Fold8 is built to power hours of entertainment. And when you do need to recharge, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁴ gets you back to what you love quickly.
        • STAY GAMING-READY: Experience what’s possible with our most advanced Galaxy Z Series processor. From immersive gaming and speedy multitasking to the latest Galaxy AI⁵ features, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 keeps for Galaxy everything running seamlessly.
        • GET LOST IN YOUR SHOTS: With a 50MP dual camera system and an expansive screen, Galaxy Z Fold8 allows you to see the details before you snap and admire your pic on an immersive display after.
        • LOCK IN TO THE MOMENT: Bring on the bumps, jumps and chaos. Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock⁶ keeps your footage perfectly upright for smooth, level footage every time.
        • A DIGITAL WALLET IS ALREADY IN YOUR GALAXY: Streamline your life, starting with your wallet. Store payment cards⁷, boarding passes⁸, digital IDs⁹, and more. All easily accessible right on your phone with a swipe up.
        • SWITCHING FROM IPHONE IS NOW EASIER THAN EVER: The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts, alarms and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to.¹³ And do it all on Galaxy Z Fold8.

        • What are the key features of Galaxy Z Fold8?

          Galaxy Z Fold8 offers a unique foldable design with long-lasting performance, advanced photography and AI features. Designed with an all-new shpae, the cover screen's 10:16 aspect ratio is perfect for scrolling.

        • What is the difference between Galaxy Z Fold8 and Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra?

          As our product line evolves, our original Z Fold model has advanced to become Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra and the Z Fold8 model has been resdesigned with an all-new shape.

        • I’m switching to Galaxy for the first time. How easy is it?

          The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to. And do it all on Galaxy Z Fold8.

        • How durable is Galaxy Z Fold8?

          Galaxy Z Fold8 is fortified with materials that strengthen the device for long-lasting durability. The Armor Aluminum frame provides enhanced protection for the device's internal components and exterior edges without adding excessive bulk.

        • Does Galaxy Fold8 support S Pen?

          No Galaxy Z Fold8 does not support S Pen.

        Product Description

        If you love to get lost in your entertainment, then Galaxy Z Fold8 is for you. This all-new foldable has an all-new shape that really makes your content shine. On the cover screen, enjoy the perfect ratio for scrolling your socials, and then unfold the wide 7.6" display¹⁰ to immerse yourself in your streaming favorites. Rotate your screen to portrait mode and the same space becomes a full-page e-book, making everything you love feel big, clear and more inviting.

        When you switch from viewing content to capturing content, Galaxy Z Fold8 is ready. With a 50MP dual camera system and an expansive screen, you can see the details before you snap and admire your pic on an immersive display after.

        This new design also sets a new record as the world’s lightest fold.¹ But don’t let that fool you —inside, you still get a 4,800mAh battery, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁴ and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chip to power your immersive on-the-go experience.

        Galaxy Z Fold8 reshapes how you enjoy content, turning every movie night, reading session and social scroll into an experience that perfectly fits your favorites.

        My Honest Take on the Galaxy Z Fold 8 (First Fold, First Impressions... and Now I'm Sold)
        I'll be upfront, I went into this hesitant coming from an iPhone 15 Pro and an S26 Ultra. This is my first foldable, and I had all the usual doubts durability, hinge wear, whether it would actually hold up as a daily driver or just end up as an expensive novelty that would be returned. A few weeks in, I can say I was wrong to worry. This thing has earned a permanent spot as my main device. What I Actually Use It For My day-to-day isn't crazy and consists of phone calls, texting, a lot of streaming (MLB, YouTube, Netflix, Disney+), web browsing, online shopping, general entertainment, and now schoolwork for my college courses utilizing DeX, however I don't use it for gaming. The Fold 8 handles all of it without breaking a sweat, and honestly, it's doing more than I expected going in. Battery life has been solid and I get plenty of juice to get me through the day. Performance For everything I throw at it, performance has been smooth. Streaming looks great on the bigger canvas, browsing is snappy, and switching between apps for coursework has been painless. I haven't run into any slowdown that made me question the hardware. This could be a different story 6-12-24 months from now, but right now this thing is snappy and smooth. One thing I cannot forget to mention is the speakers. For some the speakers will be an issue. They're on one side of the screen unfolded and it creates an off balance listening experience. This however does not bother me in particular. The more you use it the more you get used to it and if you're someone who uses headphones a lot then you really wont notice. Heat This was my biggest concern after seeing a lot of Youtube videos mention this. For me I have no overheating issues to report, with one exception. Like any phone initial setup it ran a little warm, which seems to be common with these devices during the first sync and data transfer. Since then, it's been business as usual, even during longer streaming sessions. Also to be fair, I'm not a gamer so I cannot speak to playing any games on his either. Size and Feel The screen size strikes a great balance. The front display is small enought to handle the texting and quick glance notifications, but the inner screen is big enough to actually enjoy videos and reading. Not to mention the phone itself is light and comfortable to hold, even unfolded. It doesn't feel like a brick, and it doesn't feel fragile either. It's genuinely a delight to use, which surprised me for a first foldable. For those that remember it does give a little bit of that Blackberry vibe when folded and an iPad Mini vibe when unfolded for frame of reference. The Case Situation This is really my only complaint, and it's more about timing than the phone itself. Since it's early in its release cycle, decent case options are still catching up. If you're picky about protection and style, be patient. This will improve as more accessory makers get on board. This form factor feels like it has real staying power. With foldables maturing and rumors swirling about Apple entering the space with an iPhone Ultra, I think Samsung's Fold line is positioned to be a serious competitor rather than a niche product. If my experience is any indication, this is the direction phones are heading, and Samsung has a real head start. Bottom Line I went into this skeptical and was even really nervous the first few days but came out impressed. If you've been on the fence about a first foldable, the Z Fold 8 is a strong argument to jump in.

          4 out of 5 stars
          No S pen support and Batter is improved significantly from Fold 7.
          Reviewed in the United States on August 13, 2026
          Color: GraphiteSize: 256GBStyle: Fold8Pattern Name: Phone
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          Disappointing for the Price, No S Pen Support Is a Major Step Back

          I really wanted to like the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold8, but after using it, I decided to return it. For a phone this expensive, I expected much more.

          My biggest disappointment is the lack of real S Pen support. I am a student and use my phone for serious reading, studying, highlighting, taking notes, and annotating documents. I knew about the S Pen limitation before purchasing, but I thought a good external stylus would be an acceptable alternative. It was not. The external stylus experience is nowhere near the accuracy and natural writing experience of a real S Pen. On such a large foldable screen, proper pen support would have made perfect sense.

          The battery life also disappointed me. I expected stronger battery performance from such an expensive flagship device, especially considering that the large display encourages multitasking, reading, video watching, and other demanding uses.

          The Fold8 certainly has strengths. The large folding display is beautiful, multitasking is impressive, and the phone feels premium. But those things do not justify the price for me when a feature as useful as S Pen support has been removed.

          For students, researchers, professionals, or anyone who reads and annotates documents regularly, I would think carefully before spending this much money on the Fold8. There are less expensive devices that provide proper active-stylus support and may be much more practical.

          For nearly $2,000, I expected fewer compromises, not more. I returned mine.

        About this Item

        • CREATED FOR YOUR CONTENT: Any way you turn it, the new Galaxy Z Fold8 gives you a fuller viewing experience. Designed with your content in mind, this foldable phone is the perfect size to make your movies, books and more incredibly immersive.
        • WORLD’S LIGHTEST FOLD¹: Galaxy Z Fold8 is the newest foldable phone for content on the go. Unfolded, it fits movies and books for an immersive experience. Folded, it delivers comfortable texting and everyday use — all on the world’s lightest fold.¹
        • THE BRIGHTEST DISPLAY ON A GALAXY PHONE: Our brightest smartphone display² provides you with a comfortable view, whether you’re inside or outside. Watch movies, play games and scroll with ease no matter where you are.
        • RECORD. REFRAME. READY FOR SOCIAL³: Record content on Galaxy Z Fold8 and then use My FanCam³ to keep your subject center stage. The result is a social-ready video that focuses on the part of the action you really want.
        • UNTETHER YOUR ENTERTAINMENT: The long-lasting battery of Galaxy Z Fold8 is built to power hours of entertainment. And when you do need to recharge, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁴ gets you back to what you love quickly.
        • STAY GAMING-READY: Experience what’s possible with our most advanced Galaxy Z Series processor. From immersive gaming and speedy multitasking to the latest Galaxy AI⁵ features, the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 keeps for Galaxy everything running seamlessly.
        • GET LOST IN YOUR SHOTS: With a 50MP dual camera system and an expansive screen, Galaxy Z Fold8 allows you to see the details before you snap and admire your pic on an immersive display after.
        • LOCK IN TO THE MOMENT: Bring on the bumps, jumps and chaos. Super Steady Video with Horizontal Lock⁶ keeps your footage perfectly upright for smooth, level footage every time.
        • A DIGITAL WALLET IS ALREADY IN YOUR GALAXY: Streamline your life, starting with your wallet. Store payment cards⁷, boarding passes⁸, digital IDs⁹, and more. All easily accessible right on your phone with a swipe up.
        • SWITCHING FROM IPHONE IS NOW EASIER THAN EVER: The excitement of finding your perfect foldable phone can also bring up anxiety about making the switch from iPhone. Bring over photos, contacts, alarms and passwords. Share files and encrypt messages in a way you’re used to.¹³ And do it all on Galaxy Z Fold8.

        Product Description

        If you love to get lost in your entertainment, then Galaxy Z Fold8 is for you. This all-new foldable has an all-new shape that really makes your content shine. On the cover screen, enjoy the perfect ratio for scrolling your socials, and then unfold the wide 7.6" display¹⁰ to immerse yourself in your streaming favorites. Rotate your screen to portrait mode and the same space becomes a full-page e-book, making everything you love feel big, clear and more inviting.

        When you switch from viewing content to capturing content, Galaxy Z Fold8 is ready. With a 50MP dual camera system and an expansive screen, you can see the details before you snap and admire your pic on an immersive display after.

        This new design also sets a new record as the world’s lightest fold.¹ But don’t let that fool you —inside, you still get a 4,800mAh battery, Super Fast Charging 2.0⁴ and the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 for Galaxy chip to power your immersive on-the-go experience.

        Galaxy Z Fold8 reshapes how you enjoy content, turning every movie night, reading session and social scroll into an experience that perfectly fits your favorites.
